title: Find the dearest product in each category
prompt: For every category_id that has products, return category_id, name and price of its most expensive product. Leave out products with no category. If two products in a category share the highest price, return the one whose name comes first from A to Z. Sort by category_id.
hints: A WHERE cannot use a window function. Where can the numbering happen instead?
Number the products inside each category in a WITH step, most expensive first. Then keep number 1.
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category_id ORDER BY price DESC, name) AS position, then WHERE position = 1

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses RANK, which gives tied products the same number, so both are returned.

feedback: There must be exactly one row per category. Check a category where two products share the highest price.
